'''Durge's swoop bike''' was a customized [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bike]] piloted by [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] during the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]]. He led his [[IG lancer droid/Legends|IG lancer combat droids]] into battle against [[clone lancer trooper]]s on his swoop, and briefly jousted with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].
